title: pkix-chain-simple uses pkix_path types without full re-export
description:
In pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs, the public API uses pkix_path::Error (in Error::Path variant, line 330), pkix_path::TrustAnchor and pkix_path::ValidatedPath (in function signatures and return types). The imports on lines 72-74 bring these in, but the crate does not re-export pkix_path itself.

What goes wrong: A caller matching on Error::Path(pkix_path::Error::...) must add pkix-path as a direct dependency. If pkix-chain-simple bumps its pkix-path dependency, the caller's version may conflict.

Location: pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:72-77, 330

Recommendation: Add 'pub use pkix_path;' or at minimum re-export the types that appear in the public API.
